notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l001: Ruby split and inserted in optical glass is the epic description; no silent replacement with a realistic modern lens.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l004: Six months travel is the imagined viewing range, not duration of construction.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l006: Printed Акың менде калат is positive remains with me; not silently amended to калбайт will not remain unpaid, despite next row payment. Speaker shift to patron implicit; precise assurance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l013: Repeated ring/screw adjustments retained; no telescope brand or modern mechanism invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l021: Hearth ember metaphor for trouble from his own household; literal retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l036: Seventy camel-loads of tea, not tea to feed camels; explicit tea quantity and animals retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l037: кысыр тай is a yearling from a mare remaining barren that year, hence still suckling; exact Yudakhin example https://el-sozduk.kg/sut-5/. Not barren foals or seven thousand mares.
notes.manas-2010:p1045:b001:l042: бороон күптү тай storm/cold-starved yearling; exact2015 definition https://el-sozduk.kg/бороон/. Not driven by storm or fat yearling.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l003: Daytime kumys/nighttime maidens retained as character nostalgic formula, no explicit sexual act added.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l004: шабиет game described as circle striking/dodging, primary1969/2015dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/шабиет/. English descriptive rendering rather than unexplained transliterated common noun.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l005: Exact Yudakhin formula https://el-sozduk.kg/баглан/ identifies weaned lamb and tasty head, rolling boil; бор here not wine or chalk.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l009: жыл чалыш literally year-like understood night seems year-long; raw retained. No alternate calendar or year number supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l013: огой Nogoy per edition introduction15:b002:l005; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l020: жанат qualified as fine fur, precise zoological source not securely identified; otter кундуз retained. Lexical correction2026-09-14: кундуз animal/fur means otter, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кундуз/51–54 including exact collar-endearment formula;1969/2015 aquatic carnivorous mammal supports. Earlier beaver reading corrected; raw/SHA/bbox unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l023: багалек trouser legs/cuffs; narrative condemns wasteful cutting of fine furs, not distribution to poor.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l027: Negative not twisting hair retained beside tears and later binding hair; not silently changed to tearing hair out.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l029: Quail-like eyes and blackcurrant-dark eyes retained as repeated images; no substitution with generic beautiful eyes.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l037: колоң чач long hair/braid, Yudakhin1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/колоң/. Corrected initial saddle-strap misreading; no crupper or girth in final.
notes.manas-2010:p1046:b001:l039: оорук rear camp, not hospital; old fur cap бөрк retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1047:b001:l003: Six scoundrels kept although two named earlier; no invented four names or reduced number.
notes.manas-2010:p1047:b001:l018: токчулук fullness/well-fed state retained literally in parallel with absence of Manas. Relation of saddled horse fullness to heroine action remains figuratively uncertain; no silent жокчулук/idle substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1047:b001:l022: Source frames woman as warrior/man; retained narrative gender contrast without adding commentary.
notes.manas-2010:p1047:b001:l035: Her natal family Karakan retained as named father, not normalized to Temirkan despite variants elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1047:b001:l041: Contextual lexical correction after individual image review of Manas2010 PDF1047. Yudakhin2015 кайкы I2 quotes маңдай сөөгү кайкы экен, бу Каныкей баламдын көрөр күнү тайкы эле and explains Kanykei unfortunate fate/hard life ahead. Its separate тайкы entry does give little life remaining for күн көрөрү тайкы; that was the earlier rendering basis. The paired forehead/fate formula and forecast of unsupported flight/suffering here favor the exact Kanykei hardship example, rather than a definite short lifespan. Source wording and IDs unchanged; no specialist review.
